Attendance does not include matches played behind closed doors. }} The '''2024–25 Liga Guate''', also known as '''Liga Guate Banrural''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url=https://crnnoticias.com/banrural-se-convierte-en-el-orgulloso-patrocinador-de-la-liga-guate-banrural/|title=Banrural se convierte en el orgulloso patrocinador de "La Liga Guate Banrural"|publisher=[[CRN Noticias]]|date=17 January 2023|language=es}} was the 72nd professional season of the top-flight football league in [[Guatemala]]. The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2024 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2025 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams. ==Competition format== Same as previous years, the season was divided into two short tournaments: [[#Torneo Apertura|Torneo Apertura]] (opening) and [[#Torneo Clausura|Torneo Clausura]] (closing), each of which crowning its own champion. Both [[Apertura and Clausura]] tournaments were played under the same format which consisted in a Classification phase and a Final phase.{{cite web|url=https://ligagt.org/ft/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ACUERDO-CE-030-2022-REGLAMENTO-DE-COMPETENCIA-LNFG.pdf|title=2022 REGLAMENTO DE COMPETENCIA LNFG|publisher=Liga Nacional de Fútbol de Guatemala|website=ligagt.org/|date=7 July 2022|orig-date=Approved on 27 June 2022|access-date=5 March 2023|language=es}} In the classification phase, teams played each other twice on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The top eight teams at the conclusion of the classification stage advanced to the quarter-finals of the final stage. The final phase was played on a [[single-elimination tournament|single-elimination]] format and consisted of the quarter-finals, semi-finals and the finals. All rounds were played on a home-and-away [[Two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-ranked team in the classification phase of each tie hosting the second leg. The quarter-final pairings were pre-determined based on the teams' final position in the classification phase. In the semi-finals the teams were re-seeded based also on their final position in the classification phase in order to determine the two pairings. The quarter-finals and semi-finals matchups were determined as follows: {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ;Quarter-finals *Match A: Third placed team vs. Sixth placed team *Match B: Fourth placed team vs. Fifth placed team *Match C: First placed team vs. Eighth placed team *Match D: Second placed team vs. Seventh placed team {{col-2}} ;Semi-finals *Match I: Second best placed semi-finalist vs. Third best placed semi-finalist *Match II: Top-placed semi-finalist vs. Fourth best placed semi-finalist {{col-end}} Both champions of the Apertura and Clausura tournaments plus the best placed team on the aggregate table (excluding the two champions) at the end of the season qualified for the [[2025 CONCACAF Central American Cup]]. ==Teams== A total of 12 teams took part in this season: the top ten teams from the aggregate table of the [[2023–24 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2023–24 season]] as well as two promoted teams from the [[2023–24 Primera División]] season. ===Stadiums and locations=== {{location map+ |Guatemala |width=440 |float=right |caption=Locations of the 2024–25 Liga Nacional de Guatemala teams |places= {{location map~ |Guatemala |lat=14.282778 |long=-89.8925 |label=[[Deportivo Achuapa|Achuapa]]|position=left}} {{location map~ |Guatemala |lat=14.5675 |long=-90.738056 |label=[[Antigua GFC|Antigua]]|position=left}} {{location map~ |Guatemala |lat=15.476207 |long=-90.376909 |label=[[C.S.D.
